newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Ranging stg looks for test of 2.80 marks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Ranging stg looks for test of 2.80 marks.

text.p: The pound looked set to further consolidate in its recent ranges against the mark and today's upside bias is seen capped initially at the round-figure 2.80, said chartists.
Above here, resistance in the 2.8055-mark region will provide a stronger barrier. This is an area of previous congestion as well as the range top that has held over the last two weeks.
Round-figures at 2.81 and 2.82 provide resistance above here before sterling retests the early-May multi-year high of 2.8330 marks.
However, chartists said the continuation of the rangebound conditions was seen to be putting pressure to the downside and expectations are high for an eventual break lower.

"Before it launches a sustained attack on the 2.90 level, it will break down though the lateral lines of support at 2.76 and 2.7130 and drop back to the base of the weekly price channel at 2.6750," said Howard Wright, chief analyst at Prisma Markets.
Initial support lies at 2.78 marks and then at this week's lows around 2.7650.
Cable was attempting a push higher to initial resistance at $1.65 with an eye on Wednesday's high just shy of $1.66.
Analysts said the $1.66 level, a four-month high, could prove to be a near-term top with cable consolidating below here for the time being.
Support for the pound lies initially around $1.6435, a rising trendline from last week more evident on the hourly charts, said analysts.
Below here, the round-figure $1.64 props before testing lower to $1.6330-40, a rising trendline drawn from the pound's early May lows.
